Check the total against the original invoice PDF, confirm the PO number PO-ALINFLATED against the purchase order, and ask the vendor to confirm or correct the invoice.","email_subject": "Request for confirmation of invoice RA-81392","email_body": "Dear Blouberg Industrial Supply CC team,

Thank you for submitting invoice RA-81392 dated 2025-01-16 under PO-ALINFLATED. During our review, we found that the invoice total of 21430.46 ZAR does not match the sum of the subtotal, tax, and freight listed on the invoice, which comes to 18008.79 ZAR.

Could you please review the invoice and either confirm the correct total or send a corrected invoice? Please also confirm the PO number so we can match the invoice to the correct order.

Once we receive your confirmation, we will continue processing. Thank you for your help.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable"}
